note: Adding or removing an agent changes the series and requires a methodology version bump plus recomputation of all history as new vintages.
reason: An audit of 872 collected robots.txt bodies found the v1 set substantially incomplete. Anthropic alone had four tokens in the wild against one tracked; Meta's user-initiated fetcher, Cohere's actual training crawler and Mistral were absent entirely.
inclusion_rule: A crawler operated by an identifiable organisation for AI training, AI-assisted retrieval, or the sale of crawled data as a dataset. Excluded: conventional search crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, PetalBot), SEO and marketing crawlers (SemrushBot, AhrefsBot, DataForSeoBot), B2B business-data crawlers (FactSet, Sidetrade, netEstate), generic tooling anyone can run (Scrapy, img2dataset), and tokens whose operator could not be identified.
method_caveat: Candidates were surfaced by co-occurrence: tokens disallowed in files that also disallow a known AI crawler. That works well at the head of the distribution but degrades in the tail, where a near-100% co-occurrence more likely reflects sites copying a shared blocklist template than forming an independent judgement. Inclusion was therefore decided by operator and purpose, not by the co-occurrence score.
